items.title: Bill Crow interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Gene Bertoncini was chatting up a girl on the street while he was waiting for Bobby Shanken to come down, the drummer.

ctx.x: I was going to say, “Pick one favorite story out of that.” But you just—

It’s like saying pick a favorite tune. You know I just, I really can’t do that. I always loved the one I’m involved in at the moment. I’ll give you a new story that’s not in there. Gene Bertoncini was chatting up a girl on the street while he was waiting for Bobby Shanken to come down, the drummer. And Gene is a very handsome guy and beautifully dressed usually, and very tidy. And when he told her that he was a guitar player, she didn’t believe him. She said, “You don’t look like a guitar player.” She’s thinking…
Good one. All right. Well thanks for your time.
